items.headline: Atlas-3 posts new SWE-Verify and Terminal-Ops scores
items.source_excerpt: Atlas-3 scores 71.2% on the SWE-Verify benchmark and 58.4% on the Terminal-Ops benchmark, up from 64.0% and 49.9% for Atlas-2. It was trained on 14T tokens and ships with a 400K-token context window, available from today in the API.

items.headline: Parcel 2.0 adds durable execution
items.source_excerpt: The Parcel agent framework 2.0 adds durable execution: a run that crashes resumes from its last completed step instead of starting over. Steps are checkpointed to a Postgres table, and retries use exponential backoff capped at five attempts.
